question: Rank the customer regions by revenue (price times quantity) and tell me which one is first.

sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT c.region, o.status, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.region, o.status ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

answer: The top region by total revenue is South, with 1,201,250.00 (sum of price × quantity over order items, joined through products, orders, and customers). Next are West (1,173,750), North (1,162,500), and East (1,160,000). No order status filter was applied.
